_note: Voice IDs belong to the operator's ElevenLabs account and are not guessable. The pipeline refuses to emit a voice_id it was not given. The API key is read from the environment variable named below and is never written to this file, to an episode file, or to git.

ssml._note: Emitted as <break time="..." /> tags. Confirm break-tag support for whichever model_id is set above before a full render.

defaults._note: Starting points to tune by ear on a 30-second sample, not measured optima.

lilweid._rationale: Canon voice lock: declarative and grave, short sentences that land hard. Higher stability for an even, unwavering read.

known-unknowns._rationale: Operator-assigned 2026-08-29. Matches the canon voice lock: precise, unhurried, never hypes. High stability and zero style exaggeration keep the read even; authority comes from precision, not delivery.
known-unknowns.voice_description: Young British male, serious and calm.

stickman._rationale: The operator states no Stickman voice is decided yet and prefers Eva, so this is a candidate rather than a lock. It is distinct from Johnny Kid, which satisfies the canon rule that each channel has its own narrator and they must not converge. Note that picking a voice id does not unblock canon section 7 (Voice), which still needs register, pace and sentence length read off the finished episodes. These stability settings are placeholders until tuned by ear on a 30-second Eva sample.
stickman.voice_description: Naturally rich female voice, slightly deep — confident, soothing, effortlessly engaging.
